title: Retention settings (P14)
note: Grace periods, in days unless stated. Every one is a FLOOR on how long something is kept, never a promise that it is deleted the moment it expires. continuity.md — Storage and retention is the normative text; this file is the numbers, and apps/control-plane/src/retention.ts is the only thing that reads them.

rationale.unreferencedSaveGraceDays: A Save no Anchor names any more. Long enough for someone to notice a bad restore and ask for the previous one; short enough that a busy Workstream does not accumulate a month of transcripts.
rationale.latestSavePerSessionGraceDays: The last Save of a retained producing Session stays as long as the Session does, plus this: 'what did that Session end with' should outlive the Session by a little, not by nothing.
rationale.saveWithoutPayloadGraceHours: Metadata whose bytes were never committed — a capture that died between the two commits. One hour covers a controller restart mid-shutdown; past that it is a row describing nothing.
rationale.sweepBatchSize: Rows per retention pass. Bounded work, like every other sweep.
